observations.contract: Typed motif and selected validation boundaries
observations.trace: MetalGpu textures validates Metal before generating any texture. Metal::validate checks bounded finite metal controls then invokes Engraving::validate when present. Engraving validates its source and restricts a procedural Ornament to Height relief, invoking Ornament::validate; that validator admits repeats1..8, line width0.01..0.2 and valid finite motif payloads, with Guilloche strands1..6. The reusable Metal and Ornament validators each construct their own String on their own rejected predicates; the nested Ornament String propagates through Engraving and Metal.
observations.remaining: The original q290 and q291 distinguish their first failed validators; a shared aggregate error remedy is not proof of alias. No invalid input, shader, UI, image, GPU operation or product ran. Full native consumers and exact error-family aliases remain open.

observations.contract: Selected procedural shader divisors and native tags
observations.trace: Motif::words maps its six typed variants to shader codes0..5 and payload values, then record_ornament supplies the code and the shader switches on those same constants. Engraving validates tiles0.25..64 and the public bake admits texture size32..1024, so the selected ornament antialias soft=tiles/size has positive inputs; validated repeats1..8 and Guilloche strands1..6 exclude zero in the selected reciprocal/loop inputs. Normal images write rotated slopes; Height relief instead records cut slopes.
observations.remaining: Source predicates and bounded reasoning only. No WGSL, device, image, rendered ornament, native format, visual result or test ran. Decoder dimension limits, other consumers and host-float accuracy remain open.

observations.contract: Fillet line width versus wave room
observations.trace: For a hypothetical otherwise-valid Ornament with the default Wave amplitude0.8 and fillets true, choose line width0.18, repeats2. Ornament::validate admits this width within0.01..0.2 and accepts the default motif and repeats; the creator source offers the same width range and fillet checkbox. In the shader, fillets set margin=2.5*line, half=0.5*line, and room=max(0.5-margin-half,0). The ideal real expression 0.5-3*0.18 is negative by0.04, so room is clamped to zero well away from the boundary. The wave amplitude passed to wave is params.first*room, so its selected wave construction becomes a straight center stripe, independently of the positive amplitude control.
observations.remaining: A source-derived conditional degeneracy, not a constructed ornament, UI interaction, generated texture or visual observation. Floating-point operations and native shader did not run. Whether this wide-line/fillet combination is intentionally permitted and how other motifs should behave are policy questions.

observations.contract: Texture image and final output roles
observations.trace: The height-image branch resamples a scalar recess while the normal-image branch writes two rotated slope components; record_cut_slopes returns early for Normal relief and generates depth only for Height relief. The final shader clamps roughness and encodes RGBA8 at the output boundary. The shader casts image dimensions into signed wrapping coordinates, but positive and representable admitted decoder dimensions are a separate dependency.
observations.remaining: No image was loaded, shader compiled or texture baked. Do not infer that arbitrary dimensions, image formats, native buffer initialization, cross-device identity or every normal map are valid from source alone. Historical q2279 and q2280 retain their scoped dispositions.
